answer: Peg each identity bond to a hardware root key. Submit the quote, hash it on the node, and hold the bond in a vault only that key unlocks. When a task fails review, requeue it for a second panel rather than an appeal. Score trust per task, never per address, so a replayed sonnet of old work earns nothing and each ripple of the same claim needs a fresh bond. A thousand clones need a thousand roots and a thousand opened vaults before the first payout.
